evidence.quote: rehearsals run monthly from now on

observations.why: Instituting a recurring rehearsal cadence appeals to security/readiness (conservation) and to maintaining capability through practice (competence).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: The aphoristic equivalence frames unrehearsed capability as no capability at all, appealing to genuine mastery (competence) and reliable security (conservation).
The cadence label restates the recurring-practice commitment, appealing to stability through repetition (conservation) and maintained skill (competence).
Naming an owner appeals to self-origination — the person who originates and is accountable for the practice (autonomy).

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Does the expression equate unexercised capability with absence of that capability, framing rehearsal as the proof of possession?
